faq.question: How much can I save on my electricity bill?
faq.answer: Most homeowners reduce their electricity bills by 80% to 90%. By generating your own power during the day and banking excess units with MSEDCL via net metering, you only pay the minimum fixed connection charges.

faq.question: How does the PM Surya Ghar subsidy work?
faq.answer: Under the central government's PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, residential systems receive up to ₹78,000 direct bank transfer (DBT). We register your system on the national portal and submit all documentation.

faq.question: How much roof space do I need?
faq.answer: A typical 3 kW solar system requires approximately 250 to 300 square feet of shadow-free rooftop area. We design custom elevated structures so your terrace remains completely usable below.

faq.question: Will solar work during power cuts?
faq.answer: Standard grid-tied systems automatically shut off during grid outages for lineman safety. If you need uninterrupted power during load-shedding, we also install hybrid solar systems with smart battery storage.

faq.question: What happens during monsoon or cloudy days?
faq.answer: Solar panels convert daylight radiation, not direct heat. On cloudy or rainy days in Pune, systems typically generate 35% to 50% of peak output, and your home seamlessly draws any extra units needed from MSEDCL.

faq.question: How long does the entire installation take?
faq.answer: Physical rooftop installation takes 2 to 4 days. The complete cycle including MSEDCL technical sanction, meter testing, and bi-directional net meter commissioning takes about 3 to 4 weeks.

faq.question: What maintenance do the panels require?
faq.answer: Solar panels have no moving parts. Simply washing dust off the panels with plain water every 2 to 3 weeks keeps output optimal. All Waaree modules carry a 25-year performance warranty.
